title: Majority dynamics on sparse random graphs
summary: Consider a simple undirected graph $G$ on $N$ vertices, with each vertex holding an opinion from one of two options. Starting from the initial opinions on day 1, we run majority dynamics: on each subsequent day, all vertices simultaneously adopt the majority opinion among their neighbors, retaining their current opinion in case of a tie.
